2. Scope of Work Executed
Buildings works for Lakshya Engineering & Construction completed 2016.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included expansive clay in the sub-grade requiring
additional treatment. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for
additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of a revision to the approved drawings issued
after mobilisation. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.
DOC-CC-046

3. Quality Assessment
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Excellent. Workmanship was good, with finishing
standards above the specified norm, and final inspection was completed in the presence of the client's
representative. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office were
within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. Deficiency / Observation List
At the time of taking over, two hand-railing sections replaced during the defect liability period. Regarding
site safety, a safety audit was carried out mid-contract with no major non-conformity. The agency's conduct
during the contract is recorded as cooperative, with weekly progress reporting maintained without
prompting.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2016-02-03. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. Recommendation
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the
balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by
S. Pillai, Superintending Engineer.
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
